newsitem.title: TURKEY: Trade on Istanbul gold exchange extremely quiet.
newsitem.headline: Trade on Istanbul gold exchange extremely quiet.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange saw an extremely quiet day of trade on Tuesday as volume plummeted to 85 kilos from 855 kilos on Monday.
Gold closed at $369.90 an ounce, down slightly from Monday's $370.00, but rose in lira terms to 1,297,000 lira per gram from 1,289,500 at Monday's close.
The lira eased further against the dollar, to end the year at 108,290 lira to the dollar, versus 108,020 on Monday.
There was 70 kilos of trade in the morning session and 15 kilos in the afternoon, 11.7 percent of trade was conducted in lira terms.
